_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27). City College of San Francisco 19037 (Biological Sciences A.S.) was read from PDF p.207, which its note says reads as Liberal Arts and Sciences: Emphasis in Science and Mathematics, 17954's own section (read from p.206). This read prints pp.205-208 whole and every page between pp.180 and 260 that names 'Biological Sciences', so a session can see whether the 2026-2027 catalog prints a Biological Sciences A.S. section at all, and where. One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.biological_sciences: Whether the catalog prints a 'Biological Sciences' A.S. degree section (heading, lists, total), and on which page; and the Emphasis in Science and Mathematics section's lists and total on pp.206-207.
